# pve_realm_openid (Resource)

Manages an OpenID Connect authentication realm (`type=openid`) in Proxmox VE (`/access/domains`). The upstream server validates that the supplied options fit the realm type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

resource "pve_realm_openid" "keycloak" {
  realm      = "keycloak"
  comment    = "Keycloak SSO"
  issuer_url = "https://sso.example.com/realms/pve"
  client_id  = "proxmox"
  client_key = "s3cret-client-key"
  scopes     = "email profile"
  autocreate = true
  default    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String) Authentication domain ID (PVE realm name, up to 32 characters).

### Optional

- `acr_values` (String) Authentication Context Class Reference values the Authorization Server is requested to use for the auth request.
- `audiences` (String) Additional audiences the OpenID Issuer may include beyond `client_id`.
- `autocreate` (Boolean) Automatically create users if they do not exist. Defaults to `false`.
- `client_id` (String) OpenID client ID (up to 256 characters).
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) OpenID client key. PVE may not return it, so the provider keeps your configured value and only sends it when you set it.
- `comment` (String) Description shown in the PVE login window when the realm is selected.
- `default` (Boolean) Use this realm as the default realm.
- `groups_autocreate` (Boolean) Automatically create groups if they do not exist. Defaults to `false`.
- `groups_claim` (String) OpenID claim used to retrieve groups with.
- `groups_overwrite` (Boolean) Overwrite all groups of the user on login. Defaults to `false`.
- `issuer_url` (String) OpenID issuer URL (up to 256 characters).
- `prompt` (String) Whether the Authorization Server prompts the End-User for reauthentication and consent, e.g. `none`, `login`, `consent`, or `select_account`.
- `query_userinfo` (Boolean) Query the userinfo endpoint for claims values. Defaults to `true`.
- `scopes` (String) Scopes to authorize and return, e.g. `email profile`. Defaults to `email profile`.
- `tfa` (String) Two-factor authentication configuration in PVE `pve-tfa-config` format (e.g. `type=oath`). The realm index reports the active provider instead (`yubico` or `oath`).
- `username_claim` (String) OpenID claim used to generate the unique username (e.g. `sub` or `email`).

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Realm configuration digest used by PVE to prevent concurrent modifications (read-only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Import an existing OpenID realm by its realm ID.
terraform import pve_realm_openid.keycloak keycloak
```
